answer_1.quote: We define four generation tasks of varying complexity to benchmark the ability of LVLMs to comprehend scientific plots: (1) captioning a single academic figure, (2) generating overall summaries for multiple sub-figures, (3) in-context figure captioning given previous figure‑caption pairs, and (4) generating paper titles from figure‑caption pairs.
answer_1.outputs: captions, multi‑figure summaries, contextualized captions, paper titles, multiple‑choice QA answers

answer_2.quote: Metrics BLEU-2 , ROUGE-L and BERT-Score are adopted as the automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: We also utilize GPT-4 to evaluate a sample of 500 generated captions. Specifically, we employ GPT-4 for the evaluation of single-figure caption tasks... GPT-4 is asked to perform an analysis and then produces a quality score, which is subsequently mapped to a scale from 1 to 5.
methods: prompting GPT-4 to score generated captions

answer_4.quote: We conduct a manual inspection for single-figure captioning results... We categorize captions into the following quality types: Acceptable, Over Simplification, Recognition Error, and Contextual Misinterpretation. The results of 100 manually examined captions are depicted...
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators examined generated captions and assigned them to one of four quality categories (Acceptable, Over Simplification, Recognition Error, Contextual Misinterpretation).
